paragraphs: In the morning, review literature, choose variables, prepare solutions, and run reactions. At midday, use chromatography and NMR and inspect spectra for unusual peaks. Revise conditions and rerun the experiment; in the afternoon, organize data and errors. Before leaving, update the laboratory notebook and prepare weekly reports and compliance materials.
